# Heavy / on-demand (install via the helpers in 00_setup or per-tool docs; pin what you actually use):
# --- Scaffolding (the A100-bound step; a LARGE pool — GRACE used ~10k) ---
# RFdiffusion        # classic motif scaffolding (free-tier DEMO): https://github.com/RosettaCommons/RFdiffusion ; pin the commit
# RFdiffusion2       # all-atom motif/metal-site scaffolding (Dauparas 2025) — VERIFY current public release/repo at generation time
# Riff-Diff          # theozyme->enzyme scaffolding (Schnettler 2025, Nature) — VERIFY current public release/repo at generation time
# --- Sequence design (CPU-fast; the CENTRAL tool — metal-aware) ---
# LigandMPNN         # metal/ligand-aware, fixes the His3 ligands + passes Zn as context: https://github.com/dauparas/LigandMPNN ; pin the version
# ProteinMPNN        # metal-BLIND baseline for the LigandMPNN-vs-ProteinMPNN benchmark: https://github.com/dauparas/ProteinMPNN ; pin the version
# --- Structure prediction (metal-site geometry; AF2 does NOT place the metal) ---
# colabfold          # AF2 — prefer the official ColabFold notebook; pin the commit. (ESMFold via transformers for fast triage.)
# transformers>=4.40 # ESMFold triage (EsmForProteinFolding)
# --- Functional classification + docking + dynamics ---
# CLEAN              # CLEAN-style EC/functional classification (GRACE-style triage) — mark "verify the current release/repo"
# (AutoDock) vina    # substrate fit (CO2 / pNPA toward the Zn-OH): https://github.com/ccsb-scripps/AutoDock-Vina ; pin the version
# openmm             # short metal-site MD — METAL-FF CAVEAT (see MANUAL.md §2): https://github.com/openmm/openmm ; pin the version
# pdbfixer           # structure prep for OpenMM
#
